name: Architectural Aesthetics Global Development CO.,LTD.
summary: Architectural Aesthetics Global Development CO.,LTD. focuses on the management and operation of international business hotels, with its hospitality services extending across China and Taiwan. This company, which was founded in 2002, was previously recognized as FX Hotels Group Inc. before officially changing to its present name in November 2023. Its corporate headquarters are located in Taipei, Taiwan.
